title: wg: room-policy-04 optional URI fields lack optional<> encoding
description: Suggestion. §6.5 says machine_readable_policy and human_readable_policy "optionally contain pointers" but types them as bare Uri (L919-966); "Uri parent_room<V>" (L573) has no stated cardinality relative to parent_dependant. mimid: zero-length uri is absent; parent_room has one entry exactly when parent_dependant is set (decisions mimid-1wgh.3.15, .3.18). Fix: optional<Uri>.
notes: Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY: parent_room cardinality stated; only logging URIs optional issue remains. New issue + editorial.
